verses.original: μὲν Τὸν πρῶτον λόγον ὦ Θεόφιλε ἐποιησάμην περὶ πάντων ὧν Ἰησοῦς ὁ ἤρξατο τε ποιεῖν καὶ διδάσκειν
verses.transliteration: men Ton prōton logon ō Theophile epoiēsamēn peri pantōn hōn Iēsous ho ērxato te poiein kai didaskein
verses.literal: - In my first book O Theophilus I wrote about all that Jesus - began - to do and to teach

verses.original: ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας ἀνελήμφθη ἐντειλάμενος διὰ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος τοῖς ἀποστόλοις οὓς ἐξελέξατο
verses.transliteration: achri hēs hēmeras anelēmphthē enteilamenos dia Hagiou Pneumatos tois apostolois hous exelexato
verses.literal: until the day He was taken up [to heaven] after giving instructions through [the] Holy Spirit to the apostles - He had chosen

verses.original: μετὰ αὐτὸν τὸ παθεῖν παρέστησεν ἑαυτὸν οἷς καὶ ἐν πολλοῖς τεκμηρίοις ζῶντα ὀπτανόμενος αὐτοῖς δι’ τεσσεράκοντα ἡμερῶν καὶ λέγων τὰ περὶ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: meta auton to pathein parestēsen heauton hois kai en pollois tekmēriois zōnta optanomenos autois di’ tesserakonta hēmerōn kai legōn ta peri tēs basileias tou Theou
verses.literal: After His - suffering He presented Himself to [them] - with many convincing proofs [that] He was alive He appeared to them over [a span ] of forty days and spoke - about the kingdom - of God

verses.original: Καὶ συναλιζόμενος παρήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς μὴ χωρίζεσθαι ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων ἀλλὰ περιμένειν τὴν τοῦ Πατρὸς ἐπαγγελίαν Ἣν ἠκούσατέ μου
verses.transliteration: Kai synalizomenos parēngeilen autois mē chōrizesthai apo Hierosolymōn alla perimenein tēn tou Patros epangelian Hēn ēkousate mou
verses.literal: And while they were gathered together He commanded them vvv Do not leave . . . Jerusalem but wait for the [gift] the Father promised which you have heard Me [ discuss ]

verses.original: ὅτι μὲν Ἰωάννης ἐβάπτισεν ὕδατι δὲ οὐ πολλὰς ἡμέρας μετὰ ταύτας ὑμεῖς βαπτισθήσεσθε ἐν Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: hoti men Iōannēs ebaptisen hydati de ou pollas hēmeras meta tautas hymeis baptisthēsesthe en Hagiō Pneumati
verses.literal: For . . . John baptized with water but vvv in a few days - - you will be baptized with [the] Holy Spirit

verses.original: οὖν μὲν Οἱ συνελθόντες ἠρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες Κύριε ἐν τούτῳ τῷ χρόνῳ εἰ ἀποκαθιστάνεις τὴν βασιλείαν τῷ Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: oun men Hoi synelthontes ērōtōn auton legontes Kyrie en toutō tō chronō ei apokathistaneis tēn basileian tō Israēl
verses.literal: So - [when] they came together they asked Him - Lord {will You} at this - time vvv restore the kingdom - to Israel

verses.original: δὲ Εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ἐστιν Οὐχ ὑμῶν γνῶναι χρόνους ἢ καιροὺς οὓς ὁ Πατὴρ ἔθετο ἐν ἰδίᾳ τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ
verses.transliteration: de Eipen pros autous estin Ouch hymōn gnōnai chronous ē kairous hous ho Patēr etheto en idia tē exousia
verses.literal: - [Jesus] replied . . . . . . It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own - authority

verses.original: ἀλλὰ λήμψεσθε δύναμιν τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος ἐπελθόντος ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς καὶ ἔσεσθέ μου μάρτυρες τε ἔν Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ Σαμαρείᾳ καὶ ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: alla lēmpsesthe dynamin tou Hagiou Pneumatos epelthontos eph’ hymas kai esesthe mou martyres te en Ierousalēm kai en pasē tē Ioudaia kai Samareia kai heōs eschatou tēs gēs
verses.literal: But you will receive power [when] the Holy Spirit comes upon you and you will be My witnesses - in Jerusalem and in all - Judea and Samaria and to [the] ends of the earth

verses.original: Καὶ εἰπὼν ταῦτα αὐτῶν βλεπόντων ἐπήρθη καὶ νεφέλη ὑπέλαβεν αὐτὸν ἀπὸ αὐτῶν τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai eipōn tauta autōn blepontōn epērthē kai nephelē hypelaben auton apo autōn tōn ophthalmōn
verses.literal: [After] He had said this they watched as He was taken up and a cloud hid Him from their - sight

verses.original: καὶ ὡς ἦσαν ἀτενίζοντες εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν αὐτοῦ πορευομένου καὶ ἰδοὺ δύο ἄνδρες ἐσθήσεσι ἐν λευκαῖς παρειστήκεισαν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai hōs ēsan atenizontes eis ton ouranon autou poreuomenou kai idou dyo andres esthēsesi en leukais pareistēkeisan autois
verses.literal: - - They were looking intently into the sky as He was going [when] suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them

verses.original: Ἄνδρες Γαλιλαῖοι οἳ καὶ εἶπαν τί ἑστήκατε βλέποντες εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν οὗτος ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὁ ἀναλημφθεὶς ἀφ’ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν οὕτως ἐλεύσεται ὃν τρόπον ἐθεάσασθε αὐτὸν πορευόμενον εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν
verses.transliteration: Andres Galilaioi hoi kai eipan ti hestēkate blepontes eis ton ouranon houtos ho Iēsous ho analēmphtheis aph’ hymōn eis ton ouranon houtōs eleusetai hon tropon etheasasthe auton poreuomenon eis ton ouranon
verses.literal: Men of Galilee - - they said why do you stand [here] looking into the sky This [same] Jesus who has been taken from you into - heaven - will come back in the same way . . . you have seen Him go into - heaven

verses.original: Τότε ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἀπὸ ὄρους τοῦ καλουμένου Ἐλαιῶνος ὅ ἐστιν ἐγγὺς Ἰερουσαλὴμ σαββάτου ὁδόν ἔχον
verses.transliteration: Tote hypestrepsan eis Ierousalēm apo orous tou kaloumenou Elaiōnos ho estin engys Ierousalēm sabbatou hodon echon
verses.literal: Then they returned to Jerusalem from [the] Mount - of Olives which is near [the city] a Sabbath day’s journey away

verses.original: καὶ ὅτε εἰσῆλθον ἀνέβησαν εἰς τὸ ὑπερῷον οὗ ἦσαν καταμένοντες τε ὅ Πέτρος καὶ Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἀνδρέας Φίλιππος καὶ Θωμᾶς Βαρθολομαῖος καὶ Μαθθαῖος Ἰάκωβος Ἁλφαίου καὶ Σίμων ὁ Ζηλωτὴς καὶ Ἰούδας Ἰακώβου
verses.transliteration: kai hote eisēlthon anebēsan eis to hyperōon hou ēsan katamenontes te ho Petros kai Iōannēs kai Iakōbos kai Andreas Philippos kai Thōmas Bartholomaios kai Maththaios Iakōbos Halphaiou kai Simōn ho Zēlōtēs kai Ioudas Iakōbou
verses.literal: - When they arrived they went to the upper room where they were staying - - Peter and John - James and Andrew Philip and Thomas Bartholomew and Matthew James [son] of Alphaeus - Simon the Zealot and Judas [son] of James

verses.original: ὁμοθυμαδὸν οὗτοι ἦσαν πάντες προσκαρτεροῦντες τῇ προσευχῇ σὺν γυναιξὶν καὶ Μαριὰμ τῇ μητρὶ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ σὺν τοῖς αὐτοῦ ἀδελφοῖς
verses.transliteration: homothymadon houtoi ēsan pantes proskarterountes tē proseuchē syn gynaixin kai Mariam tē mētri tou Iēsou kai syn tois autou adelphois
verses.literal: With one accord they - all continued - in prayer along with [the] women and Mary the mother - of Jesus and with - His brothers

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν ταύταις ταῖς ἡμέραις Πέτρος ἀναστὰς ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν τε ἐπὶ ὀνομάτων ἦν ὡσεὶ ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι ὄχλος τὸ αὐτὸ εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: Kai en tautais tais hēmerais Petros anastas en mesō tōn adelphōn te epi onomatōn ēn hōsei hekaton eikosi ochlos to auto eipen
verses.literal: - In those - days Peter stood up vvv among the brothers - ( a gathering of . . . - about a hundred [and] twenty ) - [and] - said

verses.original: Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί τὴν γραφὴν ἔδει πληρωθῆναι ἣν τὸ τὸ Ἅγιον Πνεῦμα προεῖπεν διὰ στόματος Δαυὶδ περὶ Ἰούδα τοῦ γενομένου ὁδηγοῦ τοῖς συλλαβοῦσιν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Andres adelphoi tēn graphēn edei plērōthēnai hēn to to Hagion Pneuma proeipen dia stomatos Dauid peri Iouda tou genomenou hodēgou tois syllabousin Iēsoun
verses.literal: vvv Brothers the Scripture had to be fulfilled that the - Holy Spirit foretold through [the] mouth of David concerning Judas who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus

verses.original: ὅτι ἦν ἐν ἡμῖν κατηριθμημένος καὶ ἔλαχεν τὸν κλῆρον ταύτης τῆς διακονίας
verses.transliteration: hoti ēn en hēmin katērithmēmenos kai elachen ton klēron tautēs tēs diakonias
verses.literal: - He was one of our number and shared . . . . . . in this - ministry

verses.original: οὖν μὲν ἐκ μισθοῦ τῆς ἀδικίας Οὗτος ἐκτήσατο χωρίον καὶ γενόμενος πρηνὴς ἐλάκησεν μέσος καὶ πάντα αὐτοῦ τὰ σπλάγχνα ἐξεχύθη
verses.transliteration: oun men ek misthou tēs adikias Houtos ektēsato chōrion kai genomenos prēnēs elakēsen mesos kai panta autou ta splanchna exechythē
verses.literal: Now - with [the] reward for [his] wickedness [Judas] bought a field [there] he fell headlong and burst open in [the] middle and all his - intestines spilled out

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο γνωστὸν πᾶσι τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ἰερουσαλήμ ὥστε κληθῆναι ἐκεῖνο τὸ χωρίον τῇ αὐτῶν ἰδίᾳ διαλέκτῳ Ἁκελδαμάχ τοῦτ’ ἔστιν Χωρίον αἵματος
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto gnōston pasi tois katoikousin Ierousalēm hōste klēthēnai ekeino to chōrion tē autōn idia dialektō Hakeldamach tout’ estin Chōrion haimatos
verses.literal: - [This] became known to all - who lived in Jerusalem so they called that - field in their own language Akeldama that is Field of Blood

verses.original: γὰρ Γέγραπται ἐν βίβλῳ Ψαλμῶν αὐτοῦ ἡ ἔπαυλις Γενηθήτω ἔρημος καὶ ἔστω μὴ ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν αὐτῇ Καί ἕτερος λαβέτω αὐτοῦ Τὴν ἐπισκοπὴν
verses.transliteration: gar Gegraptai en biblō Psalmōn autou hē epaulis Genēthētō erēmos kai estō mē ho katoikōn en autē Kai heteros labetō autou Tēn episkopēn
verses.literal: For it is written in [the] book of Psalms {May} his - place be deserted - let there be no [one] to dwell in it and {May} another take his - position

verses.original: οὖν Δεῖ τῶν ἀνδρῶν συνελθόντων ἡμῖν ἐν παντὶ χρόνῳ ᾧ ὁ Κύριος Ἰησοῦς εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: oun Dei tōn andrōn synelthontōn hēmin en panti chronō hō ho Kyrios Iēsous eisēlthen kai exēlthen eph’ hēmas
verses.literal: Therefore it is necessary [to choose] one of the men who have accompanied us vvv [the] whole time - the Lord Jesus went in and out among us

verses.original: ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ Ἰωάννου τοῦ βαπτίσματος ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἀνελήμφθη ἀφ’ ἡμῶν ἕνα τούτων γενέσθαι μάρτυρα σὺν ἡμῖν τῆς αὐτοῦ ἀναστάσεως
verses.transliteration: arxamenos apo Iōannou tou baptismatos heōs tēs hēmeras hēs anelēmphthē aph’ hēmōn hena toutōn genesthai martyra syn hēmin tēs autou anastaseōs
verses.literal: beginning from John’s - baptism until the day - [Jesus] was taken up from us [For] one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection

verses.original: Καὶ ἔστησαν δύο Ἰωσὴφ τὸν καλούμενον Βαρσαββᾶν ὃς ἐπεκλήθη Ἰοῦστος καὶ Μαθθίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai estēsan dyo Iōsēph ton kaloumenon Barsabban hos epeklēthē Ioustos kai Maththian
verses.literal: [So] they proposed two [men] Joseph - called Barsabbas ( - [also] known as Justus) and Matthias

verses.original: καὶ προσευξάμενοι εἶπαν Κύριε Σὺ καρδιογνῶστα πάντων ἀνάδειξον ὃν ἕνα ἐκ τούτων τῶν δύο ἐξελέξω
verses.transliteration: kai proseuxamenoi eipan Kyrie Sy kardiognōsta pantōn anadeixon hon hena ek toutōn tōn dyo exelexō
verses.literal: And they prayed - Lord You know everyone’s heart . . . Show [us] which . . . of these - two You have chosen

verses.original: λαβεῖν τὸν τόπον τῆς ταύτης διακονίας καὶ ἀποστολῆς ἀφ’ ἧς Ἰούδας παρέβη πορευθῆναι εἰς τὸν τὸν ἴδιον τόπον
verses.transliteration: labein ton topon tēs tautēs diakonias kai apostolēs aph’ hēs Ioudas parebē poreuthēnai eis ton ton idion topon
verses.literal: to take up . . . . . . - this ministry and apostleship - which Judas abandoned to go to his - [rightful] place

verses.original: καὶ ἔδωκαν κλήρους αὐτοῖς καὶ ὁ κλῆρος ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ Μαθθίαν καὶ συνκατεψηφίσθη μετὰ τῶν ἕνδεκα ἀποστόλων
verses.transliteration: kai edōkan klērous autois kai ho klēros epesen epi Maththian kai synkatepsēphisthē meta tōn hendeka apostolōn
verses.literal: Then they cast lots . . . and the lot fell to Matthias [So] he was added to the eleven apostles
